newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas untraded, but bids, offers actively posted.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas untraded, but bids, offers actively posted.

text.p: The IPE natural gas contract was untraded on Monday morning, although there were large numbers of bids and offers posted over the course of the morning.

By the close of the two-hour session, there were no bids posted for the first seven months of the contract, from June to December. But at times there had been both bids and offers posted for all months, even though they were mostly far apart.

"There's plenty to hit if you wanted to do it," said a futures broker, adding that it was not surprising to see a quiet Monday morning as many players are preparing strategies for the week ahead and assessing the market's direction.

But he added that there was still a reluctance for market participants to trade, rather than just buying or selling physical gas. "There's a thing against trading for trading's sake in the industry," he said.
The IPE contract saw only 55 lots traded in four separate deals over the whole of last week, and the market is hoping for better activity this week.
